high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the platform X (formerly known as Twitter). The post is titled "Fastest First Class Hundred" and commemorates an event that occurred on October 25, 1982. It mentions David Hookes, who played for South Australia, scoring 100 runs off just 34 balls during a match against Victoria. This achievement is noted as the fastest authentic First Class hundred. The post includes a video thumbnail showing a cricket match in progress. The video duration is indicated as 2 minutes and 5 seconds. The video shows a cricket player in white cricket
